// after.go.txt is the fixed text: the tool takes its temp root from the caller,
// the test hands it t.TempDir(), and the assertion is the flat one -- nothing was
// left behind -- over a directory only this test writes. It is a .txt so the
// package it sits in does not compile it; the scanner reads it as source.
package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// No snapshot, no sibling to tell apart, and the assertion did not weaken.
func TestRemovesItsWorktree(t *testing.T) {
	tempRoot := t.TempDir()
	mutate(t, tempRoot)
	entries, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(tempRoot, "nova-review-mutate-*"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a temp worktree directory was left behind under %s: %v", tempRoot, entries)
	}
}

// The same read one hop away, now over the test's own root.
func TestReadsItsOwnTempDir(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("something is in %s", root)
	}
}

// The narrowings stay silent on the fixed side too.
func TestTheNarrowings(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), "nova-review-mutate-1")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("still there")
	}
}

func mutate(t *testing.T, tempRoot string) { t.Helper() }
